text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—That Air Shakur girl debuting today
is supposed to be crazy wild.
Real edgy, delinquent-type vibe.”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, there's someone like that at Tracen?
Sounds pretty interesting. Let's go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the final checks on the PC,
Air Shakur suddenly closed his eyes.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's constant noise all around me.
If I cared about every little thing, it'd never end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is she "shutting everything out" like she said to sharpen her focus?
It's probably best not to talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Parcae indicated that regardless of the debut race's outcome,
I would still be on track for the Double Crown.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Win or lose, it's all the same.
In that case, works out fine for me.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (Is there a gap between simulation and practice, or is "Parcae" truly flawless after all?)
